verdict.rationale: Jev is an API-first product. It exposes a documented `POST /v1/systemone` endpoint and `GET /v1/models` with cURL examples and response schemas, plus typed Python and JavaScript SDKs. The docs also cover retries, error classes, rate limits, versioned model IDs and an llms.txt index, and a community user confirms working API access with sub-400ms replies. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (every probed path returned 404), and only limited independent corroboration of the API beyond anecdotal reports.
